summary: fix(settings): report readable Glean reasons for passkey errors
description:
Because:
- Passkey frontend-error Glean reasons hid which error occurred.
- Add-passkey used its own map and reported auth_error_<n> and not_supported.

This commit:
- Gives each WebAuthn error a distinct gleanReason, documented in the yaml.
- Names known errnos on add-passkey and reports duplicates as not_allowed.
- Treats only errors from the add-passkey prompt as WebAuthn errors.
- Picks the sign-in banner from errorType so banners stay the same.
- Deletes the unused fxa-shared pair-reasons.ts duplicate.

Closes FXA-14005
